description: This file defines the ParagraphElements class, a collection managing various paragraph object elements such as text, characters, hyperlinks, bookmarks, fields, images, and formatting within the MigraDoc document object model.

classes.name: ParagraphElements
classes.description: A collection class managing various objects within a paragraph, such as text, characters, hyperlinks, bookmarks, fields, images, and formatting.

classes.name: ParagraphElements.ParagraphElementsValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for ParagraphElements.

methods.name: AddText
methods.description: Adds text to the paragraph, parsing for newlines and tabs, returning the last created Text object.

methods.name: AddChar
methods.description: Adds a single character or repeated characters to the paragraph.

methods.name: AddCharacter
methods.description: Adds a Character object, either by symbol type or character, with optional count.

methods.name: AddSpace
methods.description: Adds space characters.

methods.name: AddTab
methods.description: Adds a tab character.

methods.name: AddLineBreak
methods.description: Adds a line break character.

methods.name: AddFormattedText
methods.description: Creates and adds a FormattedText object with various overloads for formatting, font, text, and style.

methods.name: AddHyperlink
methods.description: Creates and adds a Hyperlink object, with overloads for different hyperlink types and targets.

methods.name: AddMailLink
methods.description: Creates and adds a mailto hyperlink.

methods.name: AddWebLink
methods.description: Creates and adds a web URL hyperlink.

methods.name: AddHyperlinkToEmbeddedDocument
methods.description: Creates and adds a hyperlink to an embedded document, either in the current or external PDF.

methods.name: AddBookmark
methods.description: Creates and adds a bookmark field, optionally inserting at the beginning.

methods.name: AddPageField
methods.description: Creates and adds a page number field.

methods.name: AddPageRefField
methods.description: Creates and adds a page reference field.

methods.name: AddNumPagesField
methods.description: Creates and adds a total pages field.

methods.name: AddSectionField
methods.description: Creates and adds a section field.

methods.name: AddSectionPagesField
methods.description: Creates and adds a section pages field.

methods.name: AddDateField
methods.description: Creates and adds a date field, with optional format.

methods.name: AddInfoField
methods.description: Creates and adds an info field of specified type.

methods.name: AddFootnote
methods.description: Creates and adds a footnote, with optional text.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Creates and adds an image by name.
